name: Unmarried
overview: Scripture reveals that God designed marriage as the proper context for intimate relationship, as seen in Genesis where God created a suitable helper for man and established the union of husband and wife as one flesh. The Lord is also portrayed as a faithful husband to His people, emphasizing the sacredness of this covenant. Jesus teaches the seriousness of marital fidelity, condemning divorce and remarriage except in cases of fornication, which underscores the holiness of the marriage bond. Believers are encouraged to seek God's kingdom first, trusting Him to provide, which includes honoring His design for relationships and avoiding living together or sexual relations outside of marriage.
